left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Patient with germ cell tumor

Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Testicular cancer without germ cell component
-  Prior history of other malignancy except for: cutaneous cancers excluding melanoma, superficial bladder tumor, localized prostate cancer  [AND] with undetectable PSA

right.raw_text: -  Cognitive condition that would preclude patient's understanding and completion of study procedures
